title: W006 Excel MSForms UserForm Terminate object lifetime oracle fixture

cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned manifest and VBA source consumed through public Excel/VBIDE automation.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, or binary inspection.

prerequisites: Windows desktop session with Microsoft Excel installed.
Excel macro execution allowed for the generated workbook when opening the fixture.
Trust access to the VBA project object model enabled when generating through automation.
The Microsoft Forms 2.0 UserForm designer available through Excel/VBA.

scenarios.name: hide_held_release
scenarios.path: New instance is held in local and global fixture references, shown modeless, hidden with Hide, then local and held references are released separately.

scenarios.name: unload_held_release
scenarios.path: New instance is held in local and global fixture references, shown modeless, unloaded with Unload, then local and held references are released separately.

scenarios.name: modeless_system_close_held_release
scenarios.path: New instance is held in a global fixture reference after the local reference is released; public window close is sent to the modeless UserForm, then the held reference is released.

scenarios.name: modal_hide_return_held_release
scenarios.path: New instance is held in local and global fixture references, shown modal, hidden from the Activate handler to force modal return, then local and held references are released separately.

scenarios.name: modal_unload_return_held_release
scenarios.path: New instance is held in local and global fixture references, shown modal, unloaded from the Activate handler to force modal return, then local and held references are released separately.

notes.scope: This fixture builds repo-owned Excel/MSForms oracle inputs only. It does not implement OxForms behavior and does not settle final MSForms event ordering by itself.
notes.referenceState: Reference-state columns are explicit fixture state around local variables, the global held reference, and whether a default instance was intentionally used. They are not private Office reference counts.
notes.defaultInstance: The committed scenarios avoid default-instance release claims because the fixture does not have a public, reproducible way to release Excel/VBA's default UserForm instance independently from ordinary object references.
notes.generatedArtifacts: Generated .xlsm files, logs, exported worksheets, command logs, and hashes belong under docs/evidence/W006_control_implementation_rollout/ when captured.
